notes.title: Dynamic Card System / Deck Boost Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Great Architects!

Here is your High Technocrat again, ready to serve you.

We've been hard at work preparing a brand-new update for Vertical Kingdom, and we're thrilled to share what's coming your way on August 19th!

New Roguelite Feature:
Every time you start a new city, you'll be presented with 3 random special cards—unique buildings that offer distinct resources and benefits. Choose wisely, as one card will be automatically added to your deck! 

Dynamic Card System:
The cards you receive will change based on your region and progress, adding layers of strategy as you journey through the game. The closer you get to the end of a region, the more intriguing your options become!

New Buildings:
We're introducing 6 new cards tied to resource import markets, allowing you to secure resources by spending money each turn. No more relying solely on internal production—if you can generate enough cash, you can buy what you need! 

Endless Replayability:
This system is just the beginning! We’ll continue adding more cards over time, giving you fresh strategies and endless replayability.

Stay tuned for more updates, and get ready to explore new ways to build your city on August 19th! 

As I commented before many times, I greatly appreciate your dedication to playing the game and for helping me gain visibility through your reviews, which are immensely helpful. I hope you enjoy the experience!

Kind regards.
David

notes.title: New Difficulty Options & PixElated Fest!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings Great Architects![/h3]
Here is your High Technocrat again, ready to serve you.

[h2]New Difficulty Options in Vertical Kingdom![/h2]
Vertical Kingdom is gearing up to offer an even more personalized and challenging experience with the introduction of adjustable difficulty options! In response to feedback from our passionate player community, you can now choose the difficulty level for each journey you embark on in our thrilling city-building game.

Each difficulty level not only influences the amount of resources available but also the balance between the player and the empire. In easy difficulty, the empire provides resources per turn to support your growth and expansion. Conversely, in hard difficulty, the responsibility falls on you to provide resources to the empire, challenging you to manage your assets efficiently.

As part of the strategy behind these difficulty options, we have adjusted the point limits upon completing each city. In easy difficulty, the point limit is reduced, allowing you to reach this milestone earlier and granting you fewer points to invest in upgrades between journeys. Meanwhile, in hard difficulty, the point limit is significantly increased, providing you with the opportunity to earn more points to invest in upgrades and unlocks in future journeys.

With this new feature, Vertical Kingdom continues to evolve to meet the needs and desires of our players. Get ready to explore and build at your own pace!

[h2]Vertical Kingdom and PixElated Fest![/h2]
I'm super excited to share that out of thousands of applicants, Vertical Kingdom was selected to be included in PixElated Fest! Celebrate pixel-art games starting today until August 5th from retro-style classics to contemporary indie gems.

You can check out the official line-up and get more information about the event here: http://pixelatedfest.com/

notes.title: New roguelike strategy game gives city building a Terraria style twist
notes.content:
From Cities Skylines 2 and Against the Storm to the upcoming Frostpunk 2, most city building games are all about expanding your urban sprawl across a wide stretch of map. That format gets a perspective twist in new roguelike strategy game Vertical Kingdom, however, which demands you construct your cities upwards into the sky in the style of a Terraria town, earning new cards and gathering resources to help construct your towering metropolises, and it's out now on Steam with a special Steam sale discount for launch.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Draw your cards and start building!
notes.content:
[h2]Vertical Kingdom is out now![/h2]

Although it technically launched yesterday, we wanted to share our heartfelt thanks to everyone in the community who has supported the game. Your reviews, feedback, and continued support mean the world to us and we hope you continue to enjoy playing Vertical Kingdom for a long time to come!

[hr][/hr]
[previewyoutube=haHTb6mtOLs;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]🃏 Draw Cards & Build Your City[/h3]
Raise towering cities using a card-based system. Pick five decks each turn, then play the cards to build upwards. Manage resources like food, water, bricks, wood, stone, and metal, all needed to ensure the city has room to grow and play new cards.

[h3]🏰 Revive a Lost Empire[/h3]
As the Great Architect, it's your job to rebuild the Empire, one building and one region at a time. Undertake great expeditions to raise new cities in the Emperor's name and deal with the challenges of each region: Treacherous terrain, resource shortages, and ever-limited building space.

[h3]📝 Planning is Everything[/h3]
Take ownership of every decision and every card played as all buildings are permanent, no redos. Plan around and synergize with imperial citizen’s homes and workshops. Produce more taxes, resources, and maintain loyalty to the Empire - and just maybe the locals will help you with the great evil that lurks among the ruins…

[hr][/hr]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1902870/Vertical_Kingdom/

[h3]💰 Celebrate & Save During Launch[/h3]
To celebrate the game's launch, Vertical Kingdom will be [b]10% off until April 22nd![/b]

[h3]💞 Supporting Indie Games[/h3]
[list][*] If you buy the game, please consider leaving an honest review on Steam! Reviews have a massive impact on indie games and we'd love to see your thoughts and experiences through a review.
[*] Sharing the game through word of mouth with family and friends or on social media with your followers can really help spread the word and give others a chance to discover their next favorite indie game. So many indies are discovered with a simple share or casual discussion.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Dynamic Building
notes.content:
Hi! I apologize for the long silence. I was working hard on Vertical Kingdom. And you know, I'm very bad at marketing, so thank you for staying here. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41940894/0e172f1b2739d1a3cf2ab907e1990f7dc1dc776c.jpg[/img]

Right now I'm finishing the Sandbox mode and the Dynamic Building. I hope to show you a video of how the dynamic building works in the game soon. The idea is that you can build vertically and horizontally on certain buildings, and the building will change in appearance, giving the city a more organic view, I think you will love it! In fact, in my case, even knowing the tiles, I'm always surprised with the possible combinations of the buildings.

It has been a titanic work, because it required to draw a lot of tiles depending on different situations. And my goal is to allow different building combinations, for now we have the small brick house and the tower brick house, but at least the stone houses will have this option too and I hope to have time to add this feature to more buildings.

I will show you an image of my testing city in the sandbox mode. Some buildings are very ugly, but you can see the possible potential and the truly Vertical Kingdom.

I hope to prepare a video soon.

In the meantime, The pixel artist is working on a total redesign of the landscapes, and the musician is creating really nice tracks. Once I have the first landscape done I will show it here.

Thank you again for your patience!

And remember to join our discord!

notes.title: Demo Deactivation & Updates!
notes.content:
Hello fellow architects! 

I'm going to be turning off the demo for now. I know this is sad, but don’t worry. This is actually a good thing!

I am doing some major updates to the game and the current demo is not reflective of those changes. For starters, new graphics are being added to the game which I believe will enhance the experience for players. We are also adding a new feature…but I don’t want to spoil it so stay tuned!

However, we will be doing a playtest in the near future with the new demo after I finish adding the new features to the game. Very excited for you all to try the updated demo and to hear your feedback.

You can go to our  [url=https://discord.gg/xqQVJgsR26 style=button]discord[/url] to stay tuned about the new features that I will implement very soon and chat with our great community. Thanks and see you next time!

notes.title: Update of the Demo
notes.content:
Hi Great architects!

Hi! I updated the Demo with a new mode called Vertical Kingdom, this mode is a free mode, where the player can create a city without objectives and with more wide landscapes. I hope you like it!

The idea for adding this new mode is let the player play at their own pace and learn how the game works, and if they feel that they want to try something more challenging they can go to the next mode that is the expedition, that is the old mode of the game, the roguelite mode. I hope you like it.

I added a river landscape and I have to improve the cloud map and the desert map, I hope to do those soon.
I forgot, I added more buildings to the demo, I added some in the city progress tree and others in unlockable with population.

I hope you like it!

Remember that you can join our [url=https://discord.gg/xqQVJgsR26 style=button]discord[/url] and follow us on twitter!

notes.title: Publisher Announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 
I am proud to announce that Vertical Kingdom is now being published by [url=https://freedom.gg]Freedom Games[/url]. For those of you who may not know, a game publisher can take care of a lot of the business and marketing side of releasing a game. That includes managing our store pages, marketing and advertising the game, helping showcase the game at both digital and live events, PR, and a lot more. Really it lets me totally focus on working to make the game the best it can be, and provides me with the resources to do so. 

Thank you all for your support leading up to now as I couldn’t have done this without all of you. If you haven’t already please wishlist the game while you’re here and if you want to join the community, you can join our brand new [url=https://discord.gg/xqQVJgsR26]Discord [/url]or follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/FarlightGamesIn]Twitter[/url]!

notes.title: Vertical Kingdom Demo out now!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I'm happy to announce that the demo is live. After finishing some fixes I decided that this is the moment.

I'm happy and I'm anxious at the same time. This is my little love letter to the world, and I don't know what will be the response... bad, good, or worse, silence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41940894/01ed611a0d418445e045b5baf3d2eaa910a993a6.gif[/img]

During my life and career as a game developer I made a lot of mistakes, and I had to start from scratch many times. And life always gave me a new opportunity for a fresh start. So my life always has been, building something and starting again, over and over... and during this cycle I was learning new things, and thanks to that I succeeded in many new challenges that gave me a lot of happiness... I'm still learning.

Vertical Kingdom is about that, life gives us random cards and events and we have to build with that.
I hope that you enjoy the demo.

Remember... build, learn, repeat

PS: A nice way to support us is to recommend Vertical Kingdom to your favorite content creators.
